name: GB energy supply margins
value: No notice in force; 5.9 GW winter margin
summary: Cold spell in northern Britain raises demand; no Electricity Margin or Gas Margins Notice found in force on 18 Nov
state: NESO's winter outlook of 23 Oct forecasts a 5.9 GW margin, a 9.5% buffer over peak demand, and says Electricity Margin Notices are routine in most winters (NESO). National Gas expects sufficient supply, with a 99 mcm/d buffer over a 493 mcm/d peak (Pipeline & Gas Journal). Despite cold weather in northern Britain since 15 Nov, searches on 18 Nov found no Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice in force, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: No supply notices are in force. Households are not expected to see interruptions; NESO and National Gas publish any system notices on their websites.
rubric_hit: Normal: NESO and National Gas report adequate margins (5.9 GW, 99 mcm/d); no notice found on 18 Nov

sources.title: NESO — British electricity supplies secure this winter despite global instability
Pipeline & Gas Journal — UK gas grid ready for winter with 99 mcm/d supply buffer, National Gas says

why: When gas or electricity margins tighten, Britain risks price spikes and, at worst, controlled disconnections in winter.
drivers: Gas imports and storage, wind output, interconnectors, plant outages, cold weather.

rubric.alert: A Gas Deficit Warning, a high risk of demand control notice, or demand control used.
rubric.watch: NESO issues an Electricity Margin Notice or capacity market notice, or National Gas issues a Gas Margins Notice.
rubric.normal: NESO and National Gas report adequate margins; no notices issued.
